claim_limits: The two phases provide at most 3600 seconds of monitored benchmark work, not a single continuous 3600-second guard invocation.
The guard-transition interval is not monitored work and must contain no inference. It must not be described as continuous monitoring or as a baseline reset.
A resource closure proves only that the declared benchmark chain stopped and its artifacts are hash-bound; it does not assert correctness or qualification.
scope: Read-only review of the pre-inference medium two-phase monitoring amendment; no inference, lifecycle action, guard/source change, or host operation.

conditions: Use fresh disjoint create-only spec/trace/summary/closure paths for both phases.
Require successful phase-one closure and second-guard ready; abort/managed-down if identity or resource checks fail.
Bind both specs to the exact same original pre-up witness and preserve its swap baseline in final/public claims.
Do not claim --timeout 120 as an overall capacity stream deadline.

verified.baseline_continuity: Both phase specs bind the same original before-managed-candidate-up pre_arm file/hash. v2 computes every swap-growth sample against that original witness, including the second phase; it does not reset baseline to phase-two startup.
verified.capacity_timeout: Capacity cli passes timeout=a.timeout to stream_request and does not pass deadline_seconds. urllib urlopen timeout is a socket connect/read inactivity timeout; only an explicit deadline_seconds is an overall stream deadline. Therefore a continuously active 4608-token stream may exceed 120 wall seconds, while the phase guard independently limits total phase wall time to 1800 seconds.
verified.guard_limit: Each phase remains within the reviewed v2 max_seconds upper bound of 1800; no guard code or safety thresholds change.
verified.handover: First inference chain must stop and its fresh closure/summary must complete successfully. No inference occurs without a ready guard. Before phase two, current absolute resource gates and original-baseline swap delta plus unchanged PID/config must pass; phase-two guard must emit ready before historical/capacity begins.
verified.identity_continuity: Each spec/closure binds the same service, PID, process identity, model, manifest/topology/down preview. v2 rechecks PID identity at start, each sample, and closure.
verified.qualification: All deterministic, capacity, resource, and release gates remain unchanged; splitting monitoring does not convert a failed stage into a pass.
verified.successful_phase_behavior: A valid fresh closure exits v2 with arm_work_completed and intentionally leaves the service loaded; failures/deadlines/resource breaches invoke the exact preview-bound managed down.
